remarks: NOT IN A FLOOD ZONE!  Absolutely stunning! 156 Old Church Road underwent a complete gut renovation in 2017, transforming it into a high-end masterpiece. The quality is evident throughout, with meticulous attention to detail. Boasting 5 bedrooms, 6.1 bathrooms, finished lower level, and 3rd floor, this home epitomizes luxury living. Each space is a testament to bespoke craftsmanship, featuring all new and custom kitchen and bathrooms, millwork, fireplaces, sauna, bar, etc.! The beautiful patio, complete with a built-in stone fire pit, seamlessly extends the living area outdoors, creating an incredible indoor-outdoor living experience. With an open concept floor plan designed for family comfort, this residence exudes both sophistication and warmth, making it truly a unique gem.
